title: Bani Hashim Family
intro: The family of the Prophet is commonly known as the Hashimite family, named after his grandfather, Hashim bin Abdu Manaf. This was the clan entrusted with serving pilgrims in Makkah and who later endured the boycott to protect him.
treeContent: family tree bani hashim abdul muttalib children of abdul muttalib syaibah hashim amr abdu manaf abdullah abu talib hamzah abbas abu lahab harith zubair ghaidaq muqawwim dhirar safiyyah syaffa ummu hakim barrah atikah arwa umaimah sons daughters
